description: A feature flag read in the checkout service's `chargeCard` rebuilt the payment gRPC client against the unresolvable host `badAddress:50051`; the subsequent `paymentService.Charge()` failed DNS lookup and returned gRPC `Unavailable`, `PlaceOrder` returned `codes.Internal`, and the frontend surfaced HTTP 500s on `POST /api/checkout`.
mechanism:
The flag is read in the checkout service's `chargeCard` function at [`main.go#L546`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/checkout/main.go#L546). When enabled, it replaces the payment service client with one pointing to `badAddress:50051`, causing a DNS lookup failure. The checkout service creates a new gRPC client to this bad address at [`main.go#L547-549`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/checkout/main.go#L547-L549), so the subsequent `paymentService.Charge()` call at [`main.go#L552`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/checkout/main.go#L552) fails with a gRPC `Unavailable` status.

The call chain is:

1. **[`main.go#L546`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/checkout/main.go#L546)** — `chargeCard` checks the `paymentUnreachable` feature flag.
2. **[`main.go#L547-549`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/checkout/main.go#L547-L549)** — If enabled, creates a new gRPC client pointing to `badAddress:50051`.
3. **[`main.go#L552`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/checkout/main.go#L552)** — `paymentService.Charge()` fails because DNS cannot resolve `badAddress`.
4. **[`main.go#L333-335`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/checkout/main.go#L333-L335)** — `PlaceOrder` calls `cs.chargeCard()` and returns `codes.Internal` on failure.
5. **Frontend** — Surfaces the error as an HTTP 500 when the user clicks "Place Order".

variants.description: Checkout service goroutine count rose from ~856 to 964 after the incident. Each failed gRPC dial to badAddress:50051 spawns goroutines for DNS resolution and connection attempts that accumulate because the connections never succeed.
variants.onset_reasoning: Pre-incident baseline is ~855-867, slowly drifting down. At 21:31 the value jumps to 868, breaking above the prior baseline range, and continues climbing steadily to 936 by 21:48. This is the first clear upward departure after the incident time.

variants.description: gRPC client calls from checkout to PaymentService/Charge returning UNAVAILABLE (status 14). The paymentUnreachable flag redirects the gRPC dial to badAddress:50051, causing DNS resolution failure and gRPC UNAVAILABLE errors on every charge attempt.
variants.onset_reasoning: The metric is flat at 0 throughout the pre-incident baseline. The first non-zero value appears at 21:31:00 (0.0125), roughly 2 minutes after the incident time, marking the clear onset of the spike.

variants.description: Payment service PaymentService/Charge UNSET calls collapsed to zero. The payment service is never reached because the checkout service dials badAddress:50051 instead of the real payment service, so no spans are generated on the payment side.
variants.onset_reasoning: Pre-incident, the metric shows periodic activity with values oscillating between ~0.004-0.017, interspersed with occasional zeros. After the incident at 21:28:57, the last non-zero reading is at 21:32:00 (0.00416667). At 21:33:00 the signal drops to zero and never recovers. The onset of collapse is 21:31:00, the last timestamp where the diminished but still-active pattern continues before the final death at 21:33:00.

variants.description: Flagd impressions for the paymentUnreachable feature flag evaluating to the 'on' variant. Confirms the flag was activated and being evaluated by the checkout service via flagd.
variants.onset_reasoning: The metric is flat at 0 throughout the pre-incident baseline. At 21:30 UTC (about 1 minute after the incident time), the rate jumps to ~0.00417, marking the first non-zero value and the clear onset of the spike.

variants.description: Successful gRPC client calls from checkout to PaymentService/Charge (status OK=0). Dropped to zero because all charge attempts now fail with UNAVAILABLE due to the bad gRPC endpoint.
variants.onset_reasoning: The pre-incident pattern shows periodic activity oscillating around 0.0125-0.0167 with occasional brief dips to zero that recover. After the incident at 21:28:57, the signal continues at a reduced level (~0.004) until 21:32, then drops to zero permanently and never recovers. 21:32 is the last non-trivial value before the permanent collapse, aligning with the incident timing.

logs.name: POST /api/checkout → 500
logs.description: Between 21:29:24 and 21:38:10 UTC, 11 POST /api/checkout requests returned HTTP 500 with a 21-byte error response body. The DNS lookup for badAddress fails on the checkout service, so the payment service is never contacted.
logs.cause: Direct effect of paymentUnreachable flag — checkout service's chargeCard redirects payment gRPC calls to badAddress:50051 instead of the real payment service (src/checkout/main.go:546-549), causing a DNS lookup failure. The checkout service wraps this as "could not charge the card" (main.go:555-556) and returns gRPC Internal (main.go:334-335), which the frontend proxies as HTTP 500.

frontend.description: Clicking "Place Order" on the cart page returns an error — the user remains on the cart page and never reaches the order confirmation. Unlike cartFailure (which hangs for ~15 seconds), the failure is fast (~50 ms) because the DNS lookup for badAddress fails immediately. No payment is charged, no items are shipped, and the cart is not emptied.
frontend.trigger_condition: User clicks "Place Order" on the cart page while paymentUnreachable is enabled.
frontend.call_pattern: Sequential call within PlaceOrder: [`main.go#L333`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/checkout/main.go#L333) calls `cs.chargeCard(ctx, total, req.CreditCard)`, which internally creates a gRPC client to `badAddress:50051` at [`main.go#L547-549`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/checkout/main.go#L547-L549) and calls `paymentService.Charge()` at [`main.go#L552`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/checkout/main.go#L552). The charge fails before shipping or cart cleanup.
frontend.cause: The frontend API route [`checkout.ts#L18`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/frontend/pages/api/checkout.ts#L18) calls `CheckoutGateway.placeOrder`, which invokes the checkout service's `PlaceOrder` gRPC. `PlaceOrder` calls `cs.chargeCard` at [`main.go#L333`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/checkout/main.go#L333). With paymentUnreachable enabled, `chargeCard` ([`main.go#L546`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/checkout/main.go#L546)) creates a new gRPC client pointing to `badAddress:50051` and calls `paymentService.Charge()` at [`main.go#L552`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/checkout/main.go#L552). DNS cannot resolve `badAddress`, returning gRPC `Unavailable`. `chargeCard` wraps this as `"could not charge the card"` ([`main.go#L556`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/checkout/main.go#L556)), and `PlaceOrder` returns `codes.Internal` (`"failed to charge card"`) at [`main.go#L335`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/checkout/main.go#L335). The frontend surfaces the gRPC error as HTTP 500. In `CartDetail.tsx`, the `await placeOrder(...)` at [`CartDetail.tsx#L38`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/frontend/components/Cart/CartDetail.tsx#L38) rejects, so `push` to the confirmation page at [`CartDetail.tsx#L57`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/frontend/components/Cart/CartDetail.tsx#L57) never executes.

traces.name: Checkout Payment Unreachable Cascade
traces.description: Between 21:29:24 and 21:38:10 UTC, 11 traces show checkout failing to reach the payment service due to DNS resolution failure at badAddress:50051, cascading through the checkout path as HTTP 500.
traces.cause: Direct effect of paymentUnreachable flag — checkout service's chargeCard creates a gRPC client pointing at badAddress:50051 instead of the real payment service (src/checkout/main.go:546-549). DNS lookup fails with 'server misbehaving', returning gRPC Unavailable. The payment service never receives the request.
